vb_textbox.text: At first ,the gnome collecting the most seems like a random choice but then it gradually changes if you pay close attention. two certain colors always return more than the other two .At some point later in the game that changes as well , the shorter gnomes return more than others . if you aim to just find the patterns and identify when those patterns change you may collect more . you need to be quick so keyboard positioning is essential and only press once especially space button you will eventually find the rhythm so you're not too slow.
